name: Fan Deck
hint: Hover or arrow keys to part the deck. Click, Enter or tap to inspect; Esc puts it back.
description: A hand of cards fanned from a pivot below. Hover or focus lifts a card and magnetically parts its neighbours; click pulls it out to inspect beside a name plaque while the rest of the hand sinks below the table edge. Reserves its own height, keyboard and touch ready.
intents: choose one of a few options
usage: Use for choosing one of a handful: themes, plans, templates, characters, wallet cards, testimonials. 4–9 cards; on a 390px phone 5 or fewer give every card a touch region of 44px or more (7 give about 34–38px). Great above the fold on playful brands. Pass `items` [{ id, title, caption?, image?, node?, palette?, variant?, disabled? }] and `cards={items.length}` (cards caps how many are dealt; your items are never repeated). A card shows `node`, else `image`, else procedural art from palette/variant (or an art id in `art`), else a plain surface. The inspected card is `value` / `defaultValue` (an item id, or null for none) with `onChange(id, item, index)`; `onSelect(index | null)` also reports it. `label` names the deck (default "Card deck"); `disabled` dims the whole deck, takes it out of the tab order and nothing opens; with no items the empty state shows `emptyLabel` and an optional `emptyHint`. An item with disabled: true stays in the hand and in the keyboard order, is hatched and tagged Unavailable, is announced as unavailable and cannot be inspected. Keyboard: one tab stop; Left/Right/Home/End move along the fan, Enter/Space inspect, Escape puts back, Left/Right browse while inspecting. Touch: each card owns the part of the fan nearest the middle of what is visible of it; tap or drag across, release to inspect. The component sizes its own height, so give it width, not a fixed height. `demo` deals the sample art (gallery only). The cards' shadows and tilt bleed 48px past the component on each side (12px when it is narrower than 640px): keep that much room between it and the edge of the page, or the page scrolls sideways.

dataProps.type: Array<{ id, title, caption?, image?, alt?, node?, art?, palette?, variant?, disabled? }>
dataProps.description: The cards, left to right. title shows on the card and the plaque and names it for screen readers; caption shows on the plaque; image (URL) or node (ReactNode) is the face, else procedural art, else a plain surface; disabled keeps it in the hand but it cannot be inspected.
Controlled inspected card: the item's id (its index if it has no id), or null for none.
Inspected card at mount when uncontrolled.
(id | null, item | null, index | null) => void, when a card is inspected or put back (click, keys, tap, swipe, Escape, a click on the table).
(index | null) => void, the same moments as onChange with just the index (kept for older callers).
The whole deck: dimmed, not focusable, nothing opens.
Headline of the empty state shown when there are no items.
Optional second line under the empty headline. None by default (the demo shows a sample line).
Words for the Unavailable tag and the screen-reader announcements, for translation. Defaults: "Unavailable", "inspected", "put back", "of", "card deck".
With no items, deal the sample art (repeated to fill `cards`) and show a sample empty hint. Gallery only; leave off in real UI.
The root element, for measuring or scrolling to the deck. className, style and other props (data-*, aria-*) land on it too.
